subject: Correct New Westside design-state semantics: current templates are experiments, not accepted style

correction.statement: All current New Westside templates/candidates are experimental exploration artifacts only. Their existence, Storybook promotion-gate PASS, browser PASS, or use on a real-content comparison surface does NOT mean their visual style is accepted by the user or becomes Westside's canonical style.

required_semantics: Treat all current visual outputs as hypothesis space / experiments.
Do not infer user preference, brand approval, or canonical Westside style from technical gate success.
WESTSIDE_FIT is an internal evidence judgment, not equivalent to user aesthetic acceptance.
A technically qualified candidate may still be rejected aesthetically without contradiction.
Do not promote any experimental style into the canonical homepage solely because it wins automated comparison.
Any future design-memory/DESIGN.md equivalent must distinguish observed invariants from provisional experiments and explicit user-approved style decisions.
Preserve the ability to generate materially different directions rather than converging around the current experimental family.

next_engineering_effect.comparison_surface: May continue as an experiment/test harness only.
next_engineering_effect.visual_learning: Learn both positive and negative evidence from experiments.
next_engineering_effect.new_westside: Continue exploration; do not collapse candidate selection into canonical style acceptance.
next_engineering_effect.promotion_gate: Requires explicit product evidence plus explicit style-acceptance state; technical PASS alone is insufficient.

acceptance: Canonical state/register records current templates as experimental, not approved style.
Future result receipts preserve separation between technical qualification, WESTSIDE_FIT, and explicit user style acceptance.
No production homepage replacement is claimed from current candidate family without a separate explicit acceptance event.
